description: This Java source file contains a JUnit test class named SignatureSourcerTest. It includes setup and teardown methods as well as multiple test methods that evaluate the behavior of the SignatureSourcer class when parsing Java generic signature strings. The tests cover scenarios such as parsing return types, method arguments, formal type parameters, and nested generic types.
